title: Telepathic escape plan with cousin Ian

tellings.quote: communicate he communicated to me telepathically he said on the count of

plain: The UFO investigator James Fox says that once, in downtown San Francisco, his cousin Ian passed him an escape plan without saying a word: "he communicated to me telepathically," Fox says, telling him to act "on the count of" a number. Fox tells Michels this as something he lived through himself, as a personal brush with mind-to-mind contact.
